title: CI: catch a federated entry pin that moved without a version bump
summary: The manifests check validates federated sources are pinned objects but never verifies the pin actually moved to different plugin content. lore-cli v0.4.3's tag bumped package.json but not .claude-plugin/plugin.json, so opum-lore's OMARK-2 ref bump landed pointing at a tag whose plugin.json version (0.4.2) is identical to the previous pin's -- exactly the class of bug the version guard prevents for opum-workflow itself, but nothing catches it for federated entries. Extend the manifests CI check: for each federated plugin entry whose source.ref changed in the diff, fetch that plugin'\''s .claude-plugin/plugin.json at the base branch'\''s ref and at the new ref (a raw GitHub read per changed entry, not per PR) and fail if the version did not change. Decision recorded 2026-09-05 by this session, per opum-agent (orchestrator) raising it: worth building, because the read is bounded to changed entries only (currently 1, soon 2 with opum-quest) and directly closes the gap that let OMARK-2 land silently unhelpful.

acceptanceCriteria.text: manifests CI check reads .claude-plugin/plugin.json at the pinned ref for every object-source federated entry in marketplace.json
check fails when that plugin.json's version does not equal the pinned ref with a leading v stripped
check is a no-op (no network read) on PRs that do not change .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
negative-tested against a fixture shaped like the real v0.4.3 defect (ref names one version, plugin.json declares another) before trusting it
sh hooks/test/run-tests.sh and existing manifests-check behavior for non-federated sources are unaffected

plan: 2. Add a manifests CI step: for each object-source federated entry, curl its plugin.json at the pinned ref and assert version == ref with v stripped
3. Gate the step on marketplace.json actually changing in the PR diff (no-op otherwise)
4. Negative-test it locally against a v0.4.3-shaped fixture before trusting it
5. Commit, push, PR, wait for CI, squash to dev
implementationNotes: Ruling from opum-agent 2026-09-05: scope simplified. Not a diff of base-ref vs new-ref plugin.json versions -- instead, for every object-source federated entry, read plugin.json at its currently pinned ref and fail if its version does not equal the ref with a leading 'v' stripped. This is a self-consistency check (no need to know the previous pin), and directly catches the v0.4.3 case (ref v0.4.3, plugin.json version 0.4.2). Acceptance criteria replaced accordingly.
finalSummary: Added scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs: for every github-sourced, ref-pinned federated marketplace entry, fetches plugin.json at that ref and fails if its version != ref with 'v' stripped. Wired into ci.yml's manifest job, gated on marketplace.json actually changing in the PR diff (no network read otherwise). Added scripts/test/check-federated-pins.test.mjs, a network-free regression test against a local fixture server: verified it catches the real v0.4.3-shaped defect (5/5 pass), verified it fails when the comparison logic is inverted (3/5, caught the two defect-relevant cases), and ran the real checker against the live marketplace.json over the actual network (opum-lore v0.4.4, opum-quest v0.3.4 -- both pass).
